turns.content: I've gone down a rabbit hole with coffee. Started with a French press, now I have a grinder and a pour-over setup.
The pour-over rabbit hole is a deep one. What beans are you working with?
I've been ordering single-origin from a small roastery. Currently a Kenyan that's really fruity and bright.
Kenyan coffees are excellent in pour-over — the high acidity really comes through with that method.
I've been experimenting with water temperature and grind size. The variables are endless.
They really are. Brew ratio is often overlooked though — most people use too little coffee.
I've settled on 1:15. It seems to work well as a starting point.
1:15 is a solid ratio. Going slightly coarser and hotter with Kenyan tends to tame any astringency.
